opening_rule: holdout may be opened only after the exact corrected Trader candidate/version, methodology, parameters, operating envelope and evaluation thresholds are frozen; opening is one-shot for that candidate version

US30.partition_rule: cutoff = minimum last_closed_at across M5/M15/H4 minus 28 calendar days; all bars closed after cutoff are sealed holdout; downstream development artifacts must not contain them
US30.reason: US30 identity was blocked before market evidence collection, so the first valid corpus can still be partitioned before any Trader/backtest/analytics consumer sees the holdout

GBPJPY.rule: no bar/event at or after holdout_start may be used for parameter selection, radiography-driven correction, operating-envelope selection or development backtest before validation-vault opening
